column1: # package<TAB>test target<TAB>literal<TAB>occurrences<TAB>reads|cites (AET-WO-1911 §1.1). Every string literal in a Rust source
# that names a docs-only path, directory or name (ci/route.sh is_docs), one row per target and literal, with how many times the
# target's sources name it; `bash ci/route.sh check ci/docs-tests.tsv` refuses, by name, a literal missing here or named more or
# fewer times, and a row the inventory no longer finds.
#   reads  the target reads that docs-only file: it runs on a docs-only pull request (ci/route.sh docs-tests)
#   cites  the literal names a crate-level file of the same name, or cites a document without reading it
# mcp_tier1.rs reads crates/aethelgard-cli/README.md (CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR's), not the root's.
# workspace_shape.rs names README.md and LICENSE-* as files inside each crate's package, never the root's.
# readme_versions.rs reads crates/aethelgard-ir/README.md (concat! of CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR and "/README.md").
